D1.name: Snake
D1.about: one long serpentine path; pockets right beside the end cell

D2.name: Open hall
D2.about: few walls, wide open areas (few walls to localise on), 5 alcove tiles

D3.name: Comb
D3.about: 16 dead ends off one corridor, 7 tiles, close 4:3 majority

D4.name: Deep branches
D4.about: tiles at the far ends of long corridors (camera sees 1 cell ahead)

D5.name: Loops
D5.about: many loops and equal-length routes; 3 alcove tiles

R1.name: Random 1
R1.about: random DFS maze + 3 loops, random tiles and obstacle clusters (gen_random_world.py seed 1)

R2.name: Random 2
R2.about: random DFS maze + 3 loops, random tiles and obstacle clusters (gen_random_world.py seed 2)

R3.name: Random 3
R3.about: random DFS maze + 3 loops, random tiles and obstacle clusters (gen_random_world.py seed 3)

A1.name: Staircase
A1.about: zig-zag staircase: a 90-degree turn after nearly every cell; stair-shaped side branches

A2.name: Nine tiles
A2.about: 12 dead ends, 9 tiles, 5:4 majority; dead ends hidden behind walls next to the main corridor

A3.name: Long corridors
A3.about: four parallel 2 m corridors with featureless walls; dead ends out of sensor range, one right beside the end cell

A4.name: Islands
A4.about: free-standing wall islands, loops everywhere, open areas with no side walls; only 3 dead ends (boundary alcoves)

A5.name: Behind the end
A5.about: 6 cells (2 empty dead ends) reachable only THROUGH the end cell; exploration must give up on them and still finish

A6.name: Rooms
A6.about: open 2x2 / 2x3 rooms (no walls inside) joined by single doorways, tiles in closets, two empty closets in the end room

A7.name: Ladder
A7.about: two 9-cell rails joined by 5 rungs (many loops), 16 dead-end pockets beside the rails, 7 tiles 4:3

A8.name: Spiral
A8.about: 24-cell spiral dead end, the single tile at its centre right beside the end cell (behind a wall)

A9.name: Hard perfect 1
A9.about: no loops; the deepest / most branched of 3000 random perfect mazes (seed 969), 7 dead ends, 7 tiles

A10.name: Hard perfect 2
A10.about: no loops; the deepest / most branched of 3000 random perfect mazes (seed 2463), 7 dead ends, 7 tiles

A11.name: Braided 1
A11.about: random maze (seed 0) braided into 7 loops: open areas, many equal-cost routes (the A4 livelock pattern), only 3 dead ends

A12.name: Braided 2
A12.about: random maze (seed 10) braided into 6 loops: open areas, many equal-cost routes (the A4 livelock pattern), only 3 dead ends
